entity.summary: Hybrid crypto trading venue from Arkham combining centralized spot and perpetual-futures infrastructure with a newer decentralized Solana trading surface.
entity.notes: Classified limited rather than active because current first-party documentation and applications establish centralized and decentralized trading products, while the current independent centralized-exchange profile reports no tracked pairs or volume. HEI keeps Arkham's centralized exchange and decentralized Solana trading surface under one hybrid entity. No exact launch date, legal jurisdiction, predecessor, successor, terminal state, or incident event is asserted.

evidence.title: The Arkham Exchange
evidence.notes: First-party documentation describes Arkham Exchange spot and perpetual-futures trading, retail and institutional access, order types, margin controls, and insurance-fund infrastructure.

evidence.title: Introducing Arkham Decentralized Trading
evidence.notes: Official announcement states that Arkham decentralized trading launched on Solana and provides a current trading entry point.

evidence.title: Arkham exchange profile
evidence.notes: Current independent exchange profile recognizes Arkham as a centralized exchange but reports no tracked coins, pairs, or trading volume. This supports limited rather than active classification despite live first-party trading surfaces.
